# RC Georgetown — Project Summary Form

*Fill in what you know. Blanks are fine — we can follow up. The more you complete,
the faster it goes into the club's project records and website.*

**How to use:** type your answers after each `>` prompt. Don't worry about
formatting — just replace the prompt text. Return the completed form to the
project record-keeper (or paste into email).

---

## 1 · Project Identity

**Project name**
> *(e.g. "Aquaponics Workshop", "Gift of Sight")*

**Rotary year**
> *(1 July–30 June, written short: e.g. 2024-25)*

**Champion** *(the member who led it)*
> *(e.g. Mike Jackman)*

---

## 2 · The Story

**What was it? — one or two sentences**
> *(Plain description of what the project did.)*

**Why did the club do it? — the need it addressed**
> *(What problem or opportunity prompted it.)*

**Impact — what changed because of it?**
> *(The outcome in human terms. e.g. "30 members trained to build home
> aquaponics units"; "300 families received Christmas gifts".)*

---

## 3 · Classification

**Area of Focus** — pick ONE (these are Rotary's official seven):
> - [ ] Peacebuilding & Conflict Prevention *(write: Peace)*
> - [ ] Disease Prevention & Treatment *(write: Disease)*
> - [ ] Water, Sanitation & Hygiene *(write: Water)*
> - [ ] Maternal & Child Health *(write: Maternal/Child)*
> - [ ] Basic Education & Literacy *(write: Education)*
> - [ ] Community Economic Development *(write: Economy)*
> - [ ] Supporting the Environment *(write: Environment)*
>
> **My answer:**

**Type** — how was it run/funded?
> - [ ] Club *(our own project)*
> - [ ] District Grant
> - [ ] Global Grant
> - [ ] Joint *(with other clubs)*
>
> **My answer:**

**Status**
> - [ ] Planning *(not started yet)*
> - [ ] Execution *(underway)*
> - [ ] Completed
> - [ ] Dropped
>
> **My answer:**

---

## 4 · When & Where

**Start date**
> *(e.g. 2024-09 or 2024-09-15 — month is fine if you don't recall the day)*

**Completion date** *(leave blank if ongoing)*
>

**Location**
> *(e.g. Georgetown, Penang)*

---

## 5 · By the Numbers

*(Estimates are fine — write "approx." if unsure. Leave blank if unknown.)*

**Beneficiaries** — how many people helped?
>

**Project value (RM)** — total spent / value delivered
>

**Volunteer hours** *(optional)*
>

---

## 6 · Partners

**Organisations / sponsors / co-clubs involved** *(one per line)*
> *(e.g. Prudential Care; St Nicholas Home for the Blind)*
>

---

## 7 · Extras *(all optional)*

**Photos** — do you have any? *(yes/no — where are they?)*
>

**Publicity** — any news links, social posts, or write-ups?
>

**Lessons learned / would you repeat it?**
>

**Anything else we should record?**
>

---

*Thank you. This goes into the club's Service Projects record and — once
reviewed — the RC Georgetown website.*
